data.title: Gary Cardone Made $750,000 on Strategy's STRC Instead of Bitcoin, Says He'll Buy BTC at $70,000
data.description: Bitcoin CRYPTO:BTCUSD approached $86,000 after a 44% quarterly rally, but investor Gary Cardone says he isn’t chasing the move.Cardone generated roughly $750,000 from Strategy’s NASDAQ:MSTR STRC while waiting for a better BTC entry.• Where is MSTR stock headed?Cardone Says STRC Trade Paid Him $750K…
